var Document = Packages.org.jsoup.nodes.Document;
var Element = Packages.org.jsoup.nodes.Element;
            
var document = JsDom.parse(src);
            
// 获取包含<li>元素的<div>元素
var divs = document.select('ul.list > div');

// 将divs转换为数组以便排序
var divArray = [];
for (var i = 0; i < divs.size(); i++) {
    divArray.push(divs.get(i));
}

// 按照data-id属性对divArray进行排序
divArray.sort(function(a, b) {
    var pageA = parseInt(a.attr('data-id'), 10);
    var pageB = parseInt(b.attr('data-id'), 10);
    return pageA - pageB;
});

var list = [];
// 遍历排序后的divArray
for (var i = 0; i < divArray.length; i++) {
    var div = divArray[i];
    var dataId = div.attr('data-id');
    // 获取当前div下的所有<li>元素
    var lis = div.select('li');
    for (var j = 0; j < lis.size(); j++) {
        var li = lis.get(j);
        var a = li.select('a').first();
        if (a != null) {
            list.push({
                text: a.text(),
                id: dataId, // 使用data-id属性
                url: a.attr('href')
            });
        }
    }
}

//java.log(JSON.stringify(list));
list;
</js>

);
with (javaImporter) {
    function decode(content) {
        var ivEncryptedData = Base64.getDecoder().decode(String(content));
        var secretKey = SecretKeySpec(String("242ccb8230d709e1").getBytes(), "AES");
        var ivParameter = IvParameterSpec(Arrays.copyOfRange(ivEncryptedData, 0, 16));
        var cipher = Cipher.getInstance("AES/CBC/PKCS5Padding");
        cipher.init(2, secretKey, ivParameter);
        return String(cipher.doFinal(Arrays.copyOfRange(ivEncryptedData, 16, ivEncryptedData.length)));
    }
}

<js>
function styles(so) {
    var today = new Date();
    var dateT = today.getFullYear()
        + '-'
        + (today.getMonth() + 1)
        + '-'
        + today.getDate()
        + '_discover_tabs';

    var url = Api('/api/discover/tabs');
    var res = null;
    var cacheData = '';
    var sourceItem = null;
    var result = [];
    var tab;
    var count = 0;
    var i;
    var u;

    try {
        cacheData = cache.get(dateT)+"1";

        if (cacheData) {
            try {
                res = JSON.parse(cacheData);
            } catch (e) {
                res = null;
            }
        }

        if (!res) {
            res = JSON.parse(java.ajax(url));

            if (res && res.code == 0) {
                cache.put(dateT, JSON.stringify(res));
            }
        }
    } catch (e) {
        return [{
            title: '数据加载失败，请刷新后重试',
            url: '',
            style: {
                layout_flexGrow: 1,
                layout_flexBasisPercent: 1
            }
        }];
    }

    if (!res || res.code != 0 || !res.data || !res.data.sources) {
        return [{
            title: '请先登陆，登陆后刷新发现页即可',
            url: '',
            style: {
                layout_flexGrow: 1,
                layout_flexBasisPercent: 1
            }
        }];
    }

    for (i = 0; i < res.data.sources.length; i++) {
        if (res.data.sources[i] && res.data.sources[i].name == so) {
            sourceItem = res.data.sources[i];
            break;
        }
    }

    if (!sourceItem || !sourceItem.tabs || sourceItem.tabs.length == 0) {
        return [{
            title: '暂无' + (so || '') + '发现内容',
            url: '',
            style: {
                layout_flexGrow: 1,
                layout_flexBasisPercent: 1
            }
        }];
    }

    for (i = 0; i < sourceItem.tabs.length; i++) {
        tab = sourceItem.tabs[i];

        if (!tab) {
            continue;
        }

        if (tab.section) {
            if (count > 0) {
                while (count < 3) {
                    result.push({
                        title: '--',
                        url: '',
                        style: {
                            layout_flexGrow: 1,
                            layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.25
                        }
                    });
                    count++;
                }
            }

            result.push({
                title: tab.title || '',
                url: '',
                style: {
                    layout_flexGrow: 1,
                    layout_flexBasisPercent: 1
                }
            });

            count = 0;
            continue;
        }

        u = '/api/discover/content?source='
            + encodeURIComponent(sourceItem.source || '')
            + '&tab='
            + encodeURIComponent(tab.key || '')
            + '&page={{page}}&page_size=12';

        result.push({
            title: tab.title || '',
            url: Api(u),
            style: {
                layout_flexGrow: 1,
                layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.25
            }
        });

        count++;

        if (count >= 3) {
            count = 0;
        }
    }

    if (count > 0) {
        while (count < 3) {
            result.push({
                title: '--',
                url: '',
                style: {
                    layout_flexGrow: 1,
                    layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.25
                }
            });

            count++;
        }
    }

    return result;
}

var so = cache.get('sources') || '起点小说';

var s = [
    create(
        "请选择平台",
        ["起点小说", "番茄小说", "七猫小说", "书旗小说", "塔读小说","红烛故事","西瓜小说","轻小说"],
        so,
        "sources",
        1
    )
];



JSON.stringify(s.concat(styles(so)), null, 2);
</js>

<js>
  function login() {
  	 const user = String(source.getLoginInfoMap().get("账号"))
    const pw = String(source.getLoginInfoMap().get("密码"))
    let sign = java.md5Encode(`isDevice=Android&password=${pw}&phone=${user}&regDevice=2&key=87ac02d392a8d3566fe7748c8de00af3&secrect=57dcuidu8aa8062bfe8042ea65310669`).toString().toUpperCase()
    let data = JSON.stringify({
      isDevice: "Android",
      password: pw,
      phone: user,
      regDevice: "2",
      sign: sign
    })
    let op = JSON.stringify({
      method: "POST",
      body: data
    })
    let res = java.ajax(`https://api.shaoniandream.com/Login/login,${op}`)
    let $ = JSON.parse(res)
    if($.status != 1) java.toast($.msg)
    java.put("uid",$.data.id)
    source.putLoginHeader(JSON.stringify({
      logintoken: $.data.logintoken
    }))
  	}
</js>

<js>
  let $ = JSON.parse(result)
  let uid = java.get("uid") != "undefined" ? java.get("uid") : "-1"
  let array = []
  $.data.chapterList.forEach((booklet) => {
    array.push({
    	 name: booklet.title,
    	 isv: true
    })
    booklet.chapterList.forEach((chapter) => {
    	 let sign = java.md5Encode(`BookID=${$.data.id}&UserID=${uid}&chapter_id=${chapter.id}&isDevice=Android&isMarket=true&regDevice=2&key=87ac02d392a8d3566fe7748c8de00af3&secrect=57dcuidu8aa8062bfe8042ea65310669`).toString().toUpperCase()
    	 let data = JSON.stringify({
    	   BookID: $.data.id,
    	   UserID: uid,
    	   chapter_id: chapter.id,
    	   isDevice: "Android",
    	   isMarket:"true",
    	   regDevice: "2",
    	   sign: sign
    	 })
      let op = JSON.stringify({
        method: "POST",
        body: data
      })
      array.push({
        name: chapter.title,
        url: "https://api.shaoniandream.com/Booklibrary/readchapter," + op,
        time: java.timeFormat(chapter.release_time_now * 1000),
        vip: chapter.isFree == 1,
        buy: chapter.lock == 1
      })
    })
  })
  array
</js>

  var paramStr = '';
